{{Quote|Alderaan's rulers have come from House Panteer for generations.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bradel]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''House Panteer''' hailed from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], on which it was considered the most blue-blooded of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan|noble houses]]. Throughout history, House of Panteer put more [[King/Legends|kings]] and [[Queen/Legends|queens]] on the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Throne/Legends|throne]] than all other families (such as the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] or the [[House of Thul]]) combined. For ten generations before the break of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Panteer crown|crown of the Panteer]] had adorned the head of every ruler of Alderaan.

Panteer kings and queens had traditionally been patrons of the arts, but they accepted that a lie, a betrayal or even violence could be a [[Politics/Legends|political]] necessity. During the later years of the [[Great Galactic War]], at the time of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] [[Battle of Alderaan|invasion]] of Alderaan, the last uncontested ruler of Alderaan, a [[Silara Panteer|proud Panteer queen]] was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]]. Her son [[Gaul Panteer]], heir to the throne and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], was [[Death/Legends|killed]] as well.

The resulting political instability caused the remaining noble houses to break into [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]]. When rival house patriarch [[Bouris Ulgo]] declared himself king of Alderaan, House Panteer contested his rule, but were driven to hiding in the mountains. Different factions of House Panteer enlisted the assistance of the Republic and the Empire for defense and revenge. Understanding that they would be unable to reclaim the throne, House Panteer promised to support the candidate favored by the faction that succeeded in defeating Ulgo.
